title: VP of Product Development

role_match.role_rationale_from_stage3: This role owns Nazdar's ink and coating portfolio strategy, which explicitly emphasizes outdoor durability and UV resistance (2800 Series, 3500 Series, 270 Series, DCA Topcoat). The VP of Product Development would be responsible for differentiating Nazdar's offerings in a competitive market and achieving longer outdoor durability claims. Tedlar's 12-20+ year lifespan and superior UV protection could enable them to develop premium ink+overlaminate system solutions that significantly outperform their current 2-3 year outdoor durability warranties. This directly impacts their ability to compete in fleet graphics, outdoor signage, and architectural graphics segments where extended warranties command premium pricing. Their recent sustainability awards (TLMI Calvin Frost, EcoVadis Silver) suggest this leader cares about long-term performance and environmental responsibility—Tedlar's durability reduces replacement frequency, aligning with sustainability goals while strengthening product positioning.

engagement_strategy.scope_and_authority: This VP owns Nazdar's entire ink and coating product portfolio strategy, including the 2800 Series UV-LED inks, 3500 Series for fleet graphics, 270 Series with outdoor performance focus, and DCA Topcoat Clear protective solutions. They make decisions on product development roadmaps, performance specifications, warranty claims, and competitive positioning. They likely report to the Chief Commercial Officer or President and oversee R&D, formulation scientists, and product managers. This role is accountable for product differentiation, margin improvement through premium offerings, and ensuring Nazdar's technical specs remain competitive in outdoor graphics markets.
engagement_strategy.relevant_use_cases: The VP would specifically care about Tedlar for fleet graphics and vehicle wraps (where Nazdar's 3500 Series competes), outdoor signage and banners (2800 Series applications), and architectural graphics where warranty length drives premium pricing. Nazdar's current outdoor durability claims range from 2-3 years maximum—Tedlar could enable them to offer 12-20+ year system warranties when their inks are paired with Tedlar overlaminates. This transforms their competitive position in municipal signage, transit graphics, and architectural panel markets. The graffiti resistance benefit is particularly relevant for transit interiors and outdoor advertising applications where vandalism drives replacement costs. Their DCA Topcoat currently offers 36 months vertical outdoor exposure—Tedlar could become their ultra-premium overlaminate tier that multiplies this performance.
engagement_strategy.personal_stakes: This VP is measured on product portfolio profitability, competitive win rates in premium segments, warranty claim costs, and innovation pipeline strength. They personally own the challenge of differentiating Nazdar's inks in a commoditized market where competitors make similar outdoor durability claims. Premature graphic failures damage Nazdar's brand reputation and create warranty liabilities. Tedlar solves multiple pain points: it extends outdoor life dramatically (reducing warranty exposure), enables premium pricing through superior performance claims, aligns with their sustainability award focus by reducing replacement frequency, and creates a technical moat against competitors. The ability to market a complete ink+overlaminate system with unprecedented outdoor life could reposition Nazdar from ink supplier to premium graphics solutions provider, directly impacting their market share in fleet, architectural, and transit segments.
engagement_strategy.timing_factors: Nazdar exhibited at PRINTING United Expo 2024 in September and ISA Sign Expo 2024, demonstrating active engagement in their target markets. They recently received the 2024 TLMI Calvin Frost Trailhead Sustainability Award (October 2024) and 2024 Silver EcoVadis Medal, placing them in the top 15% globally for sustainability—this recognition creates momentum for solutions that reduce environmental impact through extended product life. Their 2023 OEM partnership announcement with M&R Printing Equipment shows they're actively building strategic alliances. This is an ideal time to approach with a differentiation strategy that leverages their sustainability leadership and supports their premium market positioning demonstrated at recent trade shows.

personalization_hooks.hook: Nazdar's current outdoor durability warranties max out at 2-3 years (DCA Topcoat: 36 months, 270 Series: 2 years, 2800 Series: toughest decal projects), creating a significant gap vs. what's technically achievable and limiting premium pricing power in fleet graphics and architectural applications
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Open the conversation around extending Nazdar's performance ceiling rather than defending current specs—position Tedlar as the enabling technology that lets their R&D team deliver what customers actually need for permanent outdoor installations. Frame this as a product portfolio strategy question, not a material substitution pitch.

personalization_hooks.hook: Recent sustainability awards (2024 TLMI Calvin Frost Trailhead Sustainability Award, 2024 Silver EcoVadis Medal - top 15% globally) signal that this VP values environmental responsibility alongside performance
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Connect Tedlar's extreme weather resistance and UV stability to reduced replacement frequency and waste reduction—position it as a sustainability differentiator that supports their award-winning environmental commitments while simultaneously improving profitability through premium system solutions.

personalization_hooks.hook: Nazdar competes directly in fleet graphics (3500 Series), outdoor signage (2800 Series), and architectural applications where warranty length determines market positioning and pricing power
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Position Tedlar as a strategic competitive weapon for their most premium applications—frame the discussion around how a complete ink+Tedlar overlaminate system with 12-20+ year outdoor life creates an insurmountable technical advantage in municipal fleet, transit, and architectural markets where competitors cannot match performance claims.

recommended_approach: Lead with product portfolio differentiation strategy rather than material specs. Frame Tedlar as the technology that enables Nazdar to redefine the outdoor graphics performance ceiling and capture premium market segments currently limited by 2-3 year warranty constraints. Reference their sustainability leadership and position extended product life as both environmental and competitive advantage.
